english.note: With programme approval, in-person applicants may be admitted with TOEFL80–91(old)/4.5(new),IELTS 6.5,orDET115–124, requiring arrival ESLAT and successful first-semester completion of any recommended ESL courses. IELTS Indicator7 accepted; no combined scores or IELTS One Skill Retake. Scores valid two years to enrollment. Exemption:US bachelor;US graduate/professional degree within five years;foreign bachelor exclusively English;or two graded full-time exclusively English-taught semesters within five years,excluding English-learning courses,with verified language of instruction.

applicationFee.note: International total75base+6processing. Department explicitly offers limited fee grants:contact Graduate Program Manager. International eligibility is not explicitly stated,so confirm. Central Graduate School grants remain restricted to US citizens/permanent residents. Up to three programmes share one fee. Eligible Graduate School requests are due at least five business days before the earliest deadline. The fee-grant page says new program grant purchases are suspended until further notice; confirm any departmental grant availability.

requirements.note: Central bachelor-equivalent degree before enrollment; GPA3.0 last60 undergraduate credits or master cumulative3.0. Programme-specific conditions below also apply. Programme committee minimum GPA3.0/4.0. Biological science background preferred; other physical/natural sciences considered. Faculty contact strongly encouraged; admission depends on lab fit and faculty ability to fund the degree.
